# Csharptek

> Csharptek is an Azure AI and .NET engineering partner. We help agencies, AI SaaS teams and mid-market Microsoft-stack companies take AI prototypes to production, add AI to products, automate workflows and modernize .NET applications on Azure.

## Key pages
- [Solutions](https://www.csharptek.com/solutions): AI production engineering, AI product engineering, workflow automation
- [Azure app modernization](https://www.csharptek.com/azure-app-modernization-services): .NET and Azure modernization
- [Microsoft Marketplace engineering](https://www.csharptek.com/services/marketplace): SaaS offers and co-sell readiness
- [Capabilities](https://www.csharptek.com/capabilities): AI/LLM, Azure, .NET, cloud and DevOps, data
- [Case studies](https://www.csharptek.com/case-studies)
- [Products](https://www.csharptek.com/products): TekDial, TekSocial
- [About](https://www.csharptek.com/about)
- [Contact](https://www.csharptek.com/contact)
